text: After a feud over her late grandmother's house in Gugulethu, the single mother Tsidi and her daughter Winnie [move in with her estranged mother Mavis|trigger|making a new home], who has spent [thirty years as a live-in domestic for a white Madam|wrong|exploitation for profit]. Mavis keeps them in the cramped maid's quarters though the big suburban house stands empty and Madam lies catatonic upstairs. Something [unseen pushes back as Tsidi settles in|threat|something unseen], and she turns to her grandmother's spirit to uncover [Madam's horrifying heritage|origin|family blood and inheritance].
